title: Guy Nearly Kills 4 People In An Accident Then Tries Playing Dumb
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On May 15th, 2022. Officers responded to an accident in which a car travelling at a high rate of speed hit another car and immediately fled the scene. It was said the suspect's car was completely totalled. When the officers located the suspect, he tried to act like he had no idea what happened. This is footage of the events that followed.
